title: Aggravated Assault
grade_or_penalty: 2nd degree: b(1) serious bodily injury, b(6) injury while eluding, b(13) strangulation of a DV victim. 3rd degree: b(2) deadly weapon injury, b(7) significant bodily injury, b(9)-(10) pointing firearm/imitation at officer. 4th degree: b(3), b(4) pointing firearm. b(5) assault on protected victims (officers, EMS, health care workers, teachers, transit operators, DV victims and others): 4th degree, 3rd degree if bodily injury
key_points: Attempting or causing serious bodily injury purposely or knowingly, or recklessly with extreme indifference.
Causing bodily injury with a deadly weapon; pointing a firearm at someone.
Simple assault against a protected class of victim is upgraded to aggravated assault.
elements: b(1): Attempted to cause serious bodily injury, or caused it, purposely or knowingly (or recklessly with extreme indifference)
OR b(2): Attempted to cause or caused bodily injury with a deadly weapon, purposely or knowingly
OR b(5): Committed a simple assault against a protected victim (officer, EMS, health care worker, etc.)
b(5): The victim was acting in the performance of duties (or because of their status), and the suspect knew or should have known it
Record the level of injury: none, bodily, significant or serious

subsections.label: b(1)
subsections.text: Attempts to cause serious bodily injury, or causes it purposely, knowingly, or recklessly with extreme indifference

subsections.label: b(2)
subsections.text: Attempts to cause, or purposely or knowingly causes, bodily injury with a deadly weapon

subsections.label: b(3)
subsections.text: Causes bodily injury to another with a deadly weapon through recklessness

subsections.label: b(4)
subsections.text: Knowingly points a firearm at or in the direction of another, under circumstances manifesting extreme indifference (whether or not believed loaded)

subsections.label: b(5)
subsections.text: Simple assault on a protected victim: law enforcement, firefighters, EMS, health care workers, school employees, transit operators, judges, DCP&P workers, utility workers, and others listed

subsections.label: b(6)
subsections.text: Causes bodily injury while fleeing or attempting to elude police

subsections.label: b(7)
subsections.text: Attempts to cause significant bodily injury, or causes it purposely, knowingly or recklessly

subsections.label: Other paragraphs
subsections.text: Also covers injury by starting a fire or explosion; pointing a firearm, imitation firearm or laser sight at an officer; and strangulation of a domestic violence victim. Confirm paragraph numbers and grades in the full text.
